text:
morgan: Heads up — interactive route builder hangs when you paste large header matcher map (>80 keys) and try to run schema validate in browser. Repro steps below.

elen: repro? steps?

morgan: 1) open Console -> Routes -> New
2) paste YAML

morgan: ```yaml
match:
  path: /api/*
  headers:
    X-Feature-1: exact: enabled
    X-Feature-2: exact: enabled
    # ... repeated 120 entries
```

shawn: do you have the browser stack trace?

morgan: Chrome console shows: "Uncaught RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded" from ajv.compile

dalia: ajv is running in main thread, so big patternProperties blowup stalls UI. Seen similar with deep regex list.

elen: hmm. schema currently uses patternProperties for header keys to allow arbitrary header names. That's likely causing expensive regex generation per property.

shawn: options: 1) switch to additionalProperties: {type: 'object', properties: {matchType, value}} and validate values shape; 2) restrict maxProperties in schema and surface helpful error; 3) run ajv validation in web worker.

morgan: +1 for web worker + maxProperties. web worker immediately unblocks UI, maxProperties avoids DOS via paste.

dalia: we should also add telemetry event for "route_builder.headers_count" with count bucketed (0-10, 11-50, 51-200, >200) so we can measure impact.

elen: test plan: unit tests validating schema rejects >100 header entries, e2e test that builder shows inline banner when >50 and suggests compressed format; add a fuzz test for patternProperties complexity.

shawn: patch idea: change schema header shape to an array of {name, match: {type, value}} in Console editor but accept object shape in API; migration in editor handles both. Arrays avoid large property list in JSON Schema.

morgan: quick hack reproducer attached:

morgan: ```yaml
match:
  path: /v1/predict
  headers:
    X-Flag-A: exact: true
    X-Flag-B: exact: true
    X-Flag-C: exact: true
    # ... copy-paste to ~120 lines
```

ci-bot: deploy-checks queued — please add unit tests to avoid regressions :robot_face:

elen: I'll prototype web worker + telemetry today, will push a draft PR; cc @shawn for schema design

shawn: thanks, will review. Also open question: do we want to limit header entries per route at API level? Might break existing bulk uploads.

morgan: let's aim for soft limit in Console but API keep high hard limit; also document in docs and show migration help.

dalia: FYI I've seen a few customer routes with 400+ header rules; we need to handle that for Dedicated customers — maybe server-side schema can accept big objects but Console should avoid compiling it client-side.

elen: agreed. plan: Console web worker AJV + show banner when >50, schema change to array in editor UI only, telemetry, unit + e2e tests.

morgan: thanks all, will file the RFC ticket and link PR when ready :thumbsup:
